entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. This VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF78901.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your order right here. So I can understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just... hard to use. I expected more from it, and honestly, the whole interface is confusing.
I see. And have you had a chance to look through the user manual? Sometimes there are a few tips in there that can help.
I glanced at the user manual. Didn't help. I just want to send it back.
Okay, I understand. Not a problem. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date. One moment please.

Alright, thank you for waiting, Sarah. I see here that the item was delivered 19 days ago, on December 15th. Our internal policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe.
Fine. So you'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I have just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Great. So I get my money back?
Correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
